market_model: logistic regression with market logit as fixed offset
training_grain: first evidence-backed path-state entry after date/X/path transition
entry_policy: at every new 10-minute checkpoint, if no position exists for date-X, enter on the first positive p_model minus 5-share executable cost
position_policy: generic date-X inventory state handles idempotency/HOLD/ADD lifecycle; this freeze does not authorize live ADD sizing
research_reporting_filter: cost<0.98 may be reported separately but is not training or eligibility

rejected_during_optimization.dynamic_fade_replacement: weather OOF improved but market checkpoint Brier/logloss significantly worsened versus fade-v1
rejected_during_optimization.fresh_runway_specialist_addition: point accuracy improved slightly but Brier/logloss delta confidence intervals crossed zero
rejected_during_optimization.full_dynamic_path_specialists: market checkpoint Brier/logloss significantly worsened versus fade-v1

forward_policy: score every eligible checkpoint and retain complete signal/evidence funnels; do not retune on forward
